passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.text: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.text: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.text: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.text: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.text: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

damage.value: Nami deals bonus magic damage through Tidecaller's Blessing over its short duration.

archetype.value: Nami is a support who heals, controls enemies, and can both engage and disengage.

axis.value: Nami can play safely, sustain damage, and punish missed abilities instead of forcing harass.

winCondition.value: Nami wins teamfights by chaining her crowd control with allied crowd control.

spikes.why: Nami gains exceptional value from this item.

spikes.at: Q cooldown falls from 12 to 8 seconds
spikes.why: Nami can attempt Aqua Prison more often.

bait.why: After Nami uses Ebb and Flow, its healing and damage are unavailable for 10 seconds.

mistakes.value: Nami should not upgrade Dark Seal to Mejai's Soulstealer without a decent KDA.
Nami risks being caught if she stands too far forward in teamfights.
Nami can waste her ultimate by seeking a pick when she needs it to stop an engage.
